milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the purple wool cluster (centered at spawn-relative 5,0,3) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=8 ensures the player is reasonably close (wool is ~5.8 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the wool rather than facing away.

Uses inventory_has because mining pink_wool drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 pink_wool in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining of one of the 3 placed pink_wool blocks at (~6,0,4), (~7,0,3), (~7,0,4).

Uses inventory_has because crafting white_dye from bone_meal (1:1 shapeless recipe) places the crafted item into the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 bone_meal but 0 white_dye, so having at least 1 white_dye confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because the final crafted light_gray_bed appears in the player's inventory. The player must complete a multi-step crafting chain: ink_sac→black_dye, bone_meal→white_dye, 2 white_dye + 1 black_dye → 3 light_gray_dye, 3 light_gray_dye + 3 white_wool → 3 light_gray_wool, 3 light_gray_wool + 3 oak_planks → 1 light_gray_bed. No light_gray_bed exists at episode start.
